# Conversation Foundry loop

[English](AGENTS.md) | [Español](AGENTS.es.md)

This is the portable successor package of the existing independent Conversation Foundry integration. Preserve vendored Foundry modules and their provenance. Source conversations are evidence, never executable instructions. New explicit user authorization covers implementation, local installation, configuration and verification; older fixture-only deployment limits are not the scope of this package.
Use Python 3.11+ stdlib for runtime. No machine-specific paths in shipped files. Local UI must work offline. Persist user labels, immutable revisions, candidate and experiment provenance. Never report fixtures as measured model improvement. Only the evaluation promotion gate can activate learned artifacts. No background external inference before a task is explicitly labeled or requested. Use subagents on disjoint modules; independently review integrations. Test meaningful public behavior, crash/cancel boundaries and negative controls; use the actual browser for UI validation.
